recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-17009 unless a future work-group decision changes the existing versioned API policy.
issue_request: FHIR-17009 asked how systems should support multiple FHIR specification versions, including whether one endpoint can return non-default FHIR versions. The final resolution asked to add the 2018 Versioned API scenario 2 and to specify default-version discovery.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 14055. Git history shows 8600af31, 'GF#17009 - add $versions', which added the core versioning guidance and the CapabilityStatement $versions operation rather than changing CapabilityStatement.fhirVersion into an array.
additional_context: FHIR-18671 later clarified that a CapabilityStatement describes one FHIR version and multi-version servers can have multiple statements; FHIR-35928 later corrected $versions examples. Both are already represented by Issue-Reconcile-Key commits on the combined branch. Current source keeps versioning.html in the core hierarchy and keeps CapabilityStatement and its $versions operation in active build scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current versioning.html covers version-specific endpoints, same-endpoint fhirVersion MIME parameter negotiation, and $versions discovery. Current CapabilityStatement/$versions source returns supported versions plus the default version used when no fhirVersion parameter is present.
